title: Refined global well-posedness for the periodic modulated Korteweg-de Vries equation
summary: We revisit the pathwise global well-posedness issue of the modulated Korteweg-de Vries equation (KdV) on the circle. In the previous work (2024), by combining the $I$-method and the sewing lemma, the second and fourth authors with C. Chouk, G. Li, and J. Li proved its global well-posedness in negative Sobolev spaces. This result was, however, restricted to the scaling subcritical regime $s > - \frac 32$ due to the use of the classical KdV scaling.
